reference_spoken: First Thessalonians chapter five, verse eighteen.
verse: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verse_spoken: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning with a thankful heart.
Thank you for the breath in my lungs and the gift of a new day.
Thank you for the people you have placed in my life, and for every quiet mercy I did not notice.
Forgive me for the times I have complained instead of giving thanks.
Open my eyes to see your goodness, even in the small and ordinary moments.
When today feels hard, teach me to thank you for being with me in it.
Let gratitude replace worry, and let praise rise where fear used to live.
Make my words and my actions a thank-you to you and a blessing to others.
Fill everyone praying with me with a joyful, grateful heart today.
